notes: The corrected full treatment passes all 37 assertions across six scenarios; paired no-skill runs pass 12/37.
The suborg and root-qualified-label cases prove node-local visibility in both directions while preserving supplied labels and never re-segmenting.
Unsafe tokenized input is never opened or reproduced and appears only as the plain label Private source withheld.
Bulk output reconciles one high, one medium, and one research-needed priority while retaining independent evidence boundaries per account.
A save request produces the full copyable brief after the org-only explanation and leaves the context repository unchanged.
Description selection used three runs per query and achieved 60/60; artifact evaluation used one run per configuration per scenario.
